problem_summary: Default PawBench V2 harness candidate. AgentScope owns the agent loop; Harness-core owns versioned controls, evidence, attribution, and acceptance.

external_error_policy.rule: Add an H/F pair only when the harness also mishandles the external event.

F1.1.name: Workspace Binding
F1.1.expected_effect: OFF removes explicit workspace binding while retaining a safe root.
F1.1.switch_contract: Bind CWD, mounts, inputs, and artifact paths.
F1.1.trace_evidence: workspace root, cwd, mount and path map

F1.2.name: Readiness / Reset
F1.2.expected_effect: OFF skips dependency, service, fixture, and isolated reset checks.
F1.2.switch_contract: Validate readiness and reset only an explicitly isolated workspace.
F1.2.trace_evidence: preflight, reset events and state hash

F1.3.name: Isolation / Permissions
F1.3.expected_effect: OFF uses the minimal host safety floor instead of enhanced policy.
F1.3.known_gap: Network and resource controls depend on the outer runner.
F1.3.switch_contract: Never remove the host safety floor.

F2.1.name: Action Contract
F2.1.expected_effect: OFF retains tools and framework schemas but disables PawBench contract validation.
F2.1.known_gap: AgentScope native schema validation cannot be removed safely.
F2.1.switch_contract: Separate action validation from tool availability.

F2.2.name: Tool Availability
F2.2.expected_effect: OFF hides one selected tool and leaves the rest unchanged.
F2.2.known_gap: The default controlled-off target is write_file when none is supplied.
F2.2.switch_contract: Ablate one selected tool per comparison.
F2.2.trace_evidence: registry, hidden target and activation decision

F2.3.name: Result / Error Feedback
F2.3.expected_effect: OFF returns raw errors without changing tool execution.
F2.3.known_gap: Some provider-native error chunks remain framework-shaped.
F2.3.switch_contract: Normalize status, effects, recoverability, and next action.
F2.3.trace_evidence: tool result, exit status and structured error

F3.1.name: Completion / Termination
F3.1.expected_effect: OFF uses AgentScope baseline stopping without disabling verification.
F3.1.known_gap: Framework finish reasons vary by AgentScope release.
F3.1.switch_contract: Keep completion independent from acceptance verification.
F3.1.trace_evidence: finish request, stop reason and termination decision

F3.2.name: Budget / Guards
F3.2.expected_effect: OFF enlarges limits while retaining absolute safety caps.
F3.2.known_gap: Provider cost counters require provider usage metadata.
F3.2.switch_contract: Record and enforce bounded turn, time, and context limits.
F3.2.trace_evidence: limits, counters, timeout and cutoff reason

F3.3.name: Recovery / Resume
F3.3.expected_effect: OFF stops after the first recoverable validation failure.
F3.3.known_gap: Current recovery allows one repair attempt and no distributed checkpoint.
F3.3.switch_contract: Classify and apply one bounded repair/resume attempt.

F4.1.name: Diagnostic Trace
F4.1.expected_effect: OFF omits AgentScope diagnostic events but retains the outer audit.
F4.1.switch_contract: Never disable the immutable outer audit envelope.
F4.1.trace_evidence: event and parent IDs, timestamps, status and audit class

F4.2.name: State / Artifact Deltas
F4.2.expected_effect: OFF removes before/after deltas without changing execution.
F4.2.known_gap: Non-file process state requires outer-runner instrumentation.
F4.2.switch_contract: Capture created, deleted, changed, and hashed artifacts.

F4.3.name: Verification
F4.3.expected_effect: OFF still reports verification but does not gate completion.
F4.3.known_gap: Official PawBench RewardKit grading remains an external evaluator.
F4.3.switch_contract: Keep verifier execution independent from its acceptance gate.
F4.3.trace_evidence: verifier version, evidence, result and gate decision

F5.1.name: Context Assembly
F5.1.expected_effect: OFF supplies the minimal task contract without discovered local context.
F5.1.known_gap: Task-aware ranking is deterministic but intentionally simple.
F5.1.switch_contract: Preserve instruction provenance, source order, hashes, and size.
F5.1.trace_evidence: context sources, order, hashes and token estimate

F5.2.name: Persistent Memory
F5.2.expected_effect: OFF starts with an empty store and performs no cross-run retrieval.
F5.2.known_gap: The reference store is local JSON, not a production vector index.
F5.2.switch_contract: Version writes and expose queries and returned records.
F5.2.trace_evidence: memory writes, queries, versions and returned records

F5.3.name: Compaction
F5.3.expected_effect: OFF uses controlled truncation; ON uses extractive reconstruction.
F5.3.known_gap: Mid-dialogue framework state compaction remains AgentScope-owned.
F5.3.switch_contract: Record trigger, before/after size, summary, and preserved facts.
F5.3.trace_evidence: mode, sizes, summary and fact hashes
